disclosures.text: A turbocharger comprising a shaft
A turbocharger comprising a housing
A turbine wheel mounted onto the shaft
A compressor wheel mounted onto the shaft
At least one rolling bearing located between the shaft and the housing
The rolling bearing comprises an inner ring
The rolling bearing comprises an outer ring
The rolling bearing comprises at least one row of rolling elements between raceways
Raceways are provided on the inner and outer rings
At least one intermediate sleeve radially located between the shaft and the inner ring of the rolling bearing

A turbocharger comprising a shaft, a housing, a turbine wheel and a compressor wheel mounted onto the shaft, at least one rolling bearing located between the shaft and the housing and comprising an inner ring, an outer ring and at least one
The intermediate sleeve comprises at least one end axially extending further than a radial lateral surface of the inner ring
The end of the intermediate sleeve comprises at least one positioning means adapted to cooperate with an external tool
The positioning means comprises at least one annular groove
The positioning means comprises at least one threaded portion
The positioning means comprises at least one radial hole or opening
The positioning means comprises at least one radial through-hole or through-opening made through the thickness of the intermediate sleeve
The intermediate sleeve comprises at least one axial slot provided axially on all the axial length of the intermediate sleeve
The intermediate sleeve has a stepped bore adapted to cooperate with a stepped outer cylindrical surface of the shaft
One end of the intermediate sleeve comprises a shoulder
A second rolling bearing mounted radially between the intermediate sleeve and the housing
The second rolling bearing comprises an inner ring, an outer ring and at least one row of rolling elements between said rings
The intermediate sleeve comprises a first cylindrical portion in contact with the inner ring of the first rolling bearing
The intermediate sleeve comprises a second cylindrical portion having a diameter bigger than the diameter of the first cylindrical portion
The intermediate sleeve comprises a third cylindrical portion having a toroidal surface
The third cylindrical portion forms an inner ring of a second rolling bearing
The second rolling bearing comprises an outer ring and at least one row of rolling elements between said second outer ring and said toroidal surface of the sleeve
The first outer ring and the second outer ring form one unique outer ring
The intermediate sleeve is made of a metallic material
